a customer service perspective, I recommend allowing customers to make a request for a GP appointment email and online (e.g. on the Brookborough & Tempo Surgery's website) and not only by phone.

I've been unsuccessfully calling the surgery over and over just to make an appointment and yet there's no need to speak with someone to do that. I'm sure thousands of other citizens have faced the same issue.
People should be able to email or enter their name on a website and then get an email or phone call telling them when their appointment is.

I rate the speed of booking as 1 star and the service I get at the clinic as 5 stars hence the average of 3 stars. This review is meant to be a helpful suggestion about the booking system and not criticism of the receptions or the doctors, whom I'm very grateful
